name: London flood warnings and Thames levels (Environment Agency)
gives: Flood warnings and alerts in force around London, and the latest water or tidal level at the Thames stations in London, and the nearest ten rainfall gauges (latest 15-minute total and rain per UTC day, 14 days kept), from the Environment Agency's real-time flood-monitoring API. Each warning with its severity, area and times; each station with its latest readings. Not a warning service.
